chunks: A man from the people of Abah carried something to deliver to him, and he forgot a sword in Abah. So he sent on what was with him, and he wrote to him: "What is the news of the sword which you forgot?"

key_terms.آبَةَ: Abah, the place mentioned in the report
key_terms.أَهْلِ: the people or inhabitants of a place
key_terms.سَيْفًا: a sword that was forgotten behind
key_terms.شَيْئًا: a thing or item being carried for delivery

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith describe the Imam's awareness of an item that was forgotten?
ai.summary: This report narrates that a man delivered an item but forgot a sword behind, after which a written response asked him about the forgotten sword. The narration highlights awareness of what had been omitted and serves as a brief account connected to the Imam's correspondence and knowledge of events.

en.hubeali: ‘A man from the people of Abat carried something over to him<sup>asws</sup> and he forgot a sword at Abat. So he (only) gave what was with him. So he<sup>asws</sup> (12<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) wrote to him: ‘What is the news of the sword which you forgot?’.
en.sarwar: 20. Ali ibn Muhammad has said the following.

“From A’ba (name of a town) certain items of property that belonged to the holy location (office of the Imam (a.s.) were to deliver to him ((the Imam (a.s.) but a sword that was part of such property was forgotten and remained in A’ba. When the delivery was made a letter came to him that said, “What about the sword that you forgot and left in A’ba?”
